question: Who was elected as the chairperson of the Press Trust of India (PTI) in September 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aveek Sarkar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aveek Sarkar**

 
 
• **​**Aveek Sarkar is an **Indian newspaper promoter** and **proprietor**.
 
• He is the present **Chairman** of **Press Trust of Indi**a and **Vice Chairman** and** Editor Emeritus** of ABP Group.
 
• Previously he was** editor-in-chief **of **Anandabazar Patrika** and** The Telegraph.**
 
• He was also the **Chief Editor** of **ABP Group** of publications.
 
• He was ranked as one of the most powerful Indians in 2009 by The Indian Express.
 
• **​**He was elected as the** chairperson **of the Press Trust of India **(PTI) in September 2020.****​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Press Trust of India Ltd., commonly known as PTI, is the largest news agency in India.
 
• It is headquartered in **New Delhi** and is a nonprofit cooperative among more than 500 Indian newspapers.
 
• It has over **500 full-time employees** as of 1 January 2022, including about **400 journalists.**
 
• It also has nearly **400 part-time correspondents **in most of the district headquarters of the country.
 
• PTI also has correspondents in major capitals and important business centres around the world.
 
• It took over the operations of the Associated Press of India from Reuters in **1948–49.**
 
• It provides news coverage and information of the region in both English and Hindi.
